and_control_scope: Measured canonical motifs only; not Zoe or a general size/coupling law.
exploratory_search_scope: The saved five-element searches are sampled, not exhaustive. The search artifacts were reviewed but not independently rerun.
full_suite_failure_scope: The same two image_path/version-skew failures occur before and after the patch.
minimal_cut_note: An equal-valued minimal cut can be selected differently across runs; the cut label is not unique evidence of learning.
prediction_semantics: The wired observation is accessible_volume > 0 and prediction is predicted_token_index > 0. The token index is not a forecast of that observation bit, so the XOR is not meaningful prediction error.
reason_not_adopted: The useful result is state-dependent candidate selection. Semantic bit labels and XOR agreement are not a measured generative model, a real belief update, or autonomous self-reflection.
zoe_alternative: Measured stereo prediction errors, likelihood-based model weights, goal-directed actions, held-out validation, reversible adoption, and replayable self-reflection evidence.
